EXPLANATORY HANDBOOK to

i. Breaking away the concreto along vertical slots
to separate the wall section.
Width of wall section shall be determined by the RSE.
Reinforcing bars shall be left to stabilise
the section.
Breaking of concrete shall be done cautiously to
minimise debris from falling outside the building.
